LineComment.Text:
Mode select is done via the HMI. Might add external mode select switches.
Mode select mask: 0: Disabled 1: Manual 2: Semi-Auto 3: Auto 4: Teach - N/A for Cnv 5: Maintenance
Device ID Format: XXYYZZ XX = Device type 40 VTD 10 Cnv_Front_of_VTD 11 Cnv_Rear_of_VTD 12 Cnv_On_Extractor 20 Safety_Stop_Front_of_VTD 21 Safety_Stop_Rear_of_VTD
YY = Floor ZZ = VTD Connected to Example: 110203 Conveyor at the rear of VTD 3 on level 2
SAFETY PINS (IT DOESN'T EXIST IN ECONVEYORS)
Both sensors triggered after a timer
Forward sensor triggered and not running
Backward sensor triggered and not running
No sensor detected and Conveyor not running
Standby - Conveyor ready to receive instruction
Extractor not at the correct level
14:3 Cnv cannot transfer to that location
Check conditions to stop the motor
Stop the motor if the conveyor is not occupied anymore
Stop the motor if the conveyor is occupied
If the watchdog bites, kill the process
